## Football effect

Jensen played three offensive snaps and one kicking-game snap in Henne's mixed group before the injury was logged, with no catch or target; Marcedes Lewis took his place in Wilson's, Bray's and Shaw's tight-end groups for the rest of the game, the kernel's replacement under the frozen chart. The hold is the medical staff's and no football finding attaches to it. On the projection he misses the August 23 to 25 practices and is reassessed August 24; the August 28 game against Atlanta falls on his projected return date, and his availability for it follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. His game-2 work (the 29-yard third-and-1 catch and a coverage tackle) and his camp blocking evidence stand as recorded; the TE3 comparison with Hoskins received nothing from his side in this game. A release does not automatically restore a role, and no role was set.
